title: Reunion with an Old Acquaintance
next_chapter_hook: "The figure of the Demonic Path commander vanished beyond the palace gates. The turtle shell fragment in Chen Ji's hand suddenly flickered with a faint glow—a warning of resonance with an old acquaintance's aura. At that moment, a familiar scent, enough to pierce the soul, quietly approached from the western suburbs of the imperial capital."

text.content: "The moment that voice pierced through the clamor, Chen Ji felt something in his chest shatter. He spun around, seeing a frail figure pushing through the crowd—it was her, Chen Nian. His sister, missing for eight years, stood just under thirty feet away, ragged clothes, sallow and emaciated, yet those eyes still as clear as in childhood."

"Chen Ji's feet never moved, his expressioncalm如常 as ever, only his right hand hanging at his side trembling slightly. He didn't rush forward—years of caution told him that the more turbulent the emotions, the more one must remain calm. The commotion in the crowd grew larger; someone had already recognized this sudden appearance of the girl connected totrash陈."

dialogue.content: "(In a low voice) Xiao Nian, how… could you be here?"

text.content: "But before Chen Nian could answer, the sky suddenly darkened. A boundless demonic pressure descended from the horizon, and everyone looked up in unison—to see a black glow slash across the sky, landing squarely in the center of the imperial plaza. As the dust settled, a figure in dark black battle armor slowly revealed itself, demonic energy churning around them like a tide."

dialogue.content: "Demonic Path Holy Sect Commander, paying respects to Tianqing Sect's Chen Daoist Friend."

text.content: "Chen Ji's brow center stirred. The newcomer's cultivation was unfathomable—at the very least, a supreme expert of the Tribulation Transcending Late Stage. More strangely, the aura emanating from them filled him with an inexplicable familiarity—a breath from the same ancient lineage as the turtle shell artifact. His right hand secretly slipped into his sleeve, touching the faintly warm fragment."

dialogue.content: "No need for tension, Chen Daoist Friend. This commander did not come for war. On the contrary—I have come to fulfill a contract."

text.content: "'Fulfill a contract?' Chen Ji sneered inwardly. He had never made any pact with the Demonic Path, yet the other spoke with such certainty, clearly laying a trap. He calmly positioned Chen Nian behind him while scanning the surroundings with peripheral vision—Su Qingyao had vanished, whether to summon troops or investigate this uninvited guest."

"Chen Daoist Friend, do you know the truth behind that calamity ten thousand years ago? The Demonic Path commander suddenly lowered his voice, demonic energy forming a barrier that sealed out everything. When the world was first created, there were seven 'Fate Scribes.' Together, they sealed the dimensional invaders—now the seal is about to break, and we need each other."

dialogue.content: "(Calmly) I am merely a servant disciple. You have come to the wrong person."
"Is that so? Then what is your explanation for the fragment in your sleeve?"

choice.prompt: "The Demonic Path commander directly exposed the existence of the Tianji Record fragment. Chen Ji must respond."

choices.text: "Acknowledge it顺势 and test the possibility of cooperation"
choices.description: "Since the other party already knows the cards, one might as well大方承认 and see what the Demonic Path truly wants. Cooperating against dimensional invaders sounds absurd, but there may be room for maneuvering."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain intelligence from the Demonic Path about dimensional invaders"
choices.risk_hint: "The Demonic Path commander is extremely scheming and likely has hidden calculations"

text.content: "Chen Ji沉默了片刻, then slowly drew the turtle shell fragment from his sleeve. The patterns on the fragment still flickered with a faint glow within the demonic barrier, as if responding to something. Upon seeing this, the Demonic Path commander's eyes flashed with a barely perceptible relief."

dialogue.content: "As expected, the Tianji Record Fragment. Good, Chen Daoist Friend is indeed a wise one."

choices.text: "Question the other's motives and maintain vigilance"
choices.description: "The Demonic Path has always been treacherous; this person coming uninvited must have ulterior motives. Rather than passively waiting for the other to reveal their cards, one should take the initiative to probe their true intentions."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain more intelligence from the other's reactions"
choices.risk_hint: "The other party is a Tribulation Transcending Late Stage expert; frontal confrontation is extremely unfavorable"
choices.process_label: retreat to advance, force their hand

text.content: "Chen Ji收回ed the fragment into his sleeve, his smile not diminishing but growing. He stepped forward slowly, gazing into the Demonic Path commander's eyes. Those ordinarily timorous eyes now revealed a sharpness that seemed to pierce through all. The Demonic Path commander raised a brow slightly, seemingly gaining new recognition of this 'trash' disciple."

dialogue.content: "The Fate Scribes of ten thousand years ago—how does the honored one know of them? Is the Demonic Path's intelligence network truly so omnipotent?"

choices.text: "Secretly activate the Tianji Record to probe this person's origins"
choices.description: "This person shares the same-source aura as the turtle shell artifact—this cannot be coincidence. Rather than speculate, one should use the Tianji Record to foresee this person's movements over the next three hours, but the cost is consuming 5 points of Heavenly Fate."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain complete intelligence on the Demonic Path commander's intentions and weaknesses"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate is extremely precious, and this person's aura may interfere with divination"

text.content: "Chen Ji secretly stirred the fragment in his sleeve, a thread of profound energy extending from his fingertips. But the moment he tried to seize the other's fate trajectory, a violent dizziness struck—the visions of foresight became blurred, as if some force was interfering. Only a few fragments flashed by: an ancient list, and a woman whose face resembled Su Qingyao's."

dialogue.content: "(meaningful) Chen Daoist Friend, it seems the aura on your sister is also interfering with your abilities."

text.content: "The Demonic Path commander seemed to have anticipated Chen Ji's reaction long ago. Unhurriedly, he unfolded his palm, and a jade slip gleaming with a faint幽光 floated out. On the jade slip,赫然刻着 seven names—the last one was precisely 'Su Qingyao,' and at the very top, a name was already shrouded in black qi, its original characters illegible."

dialogue.content: "This is the registry of the seven Fate Scribes from ten thousand years ago. Su Qingyao is the reincarnation of the Seventh Scribe—and the only reincarnation who retains her past life's memories. If she awakens, she becomes your most powerful ally; if she does not awaken… she becomes the most fatal weakness."

text.content: "Chen Ji's gazeprofound. He had long suspected the mystery surrounding Su Qingyao's origins—this woman possessed extraordinary talent yet unclear background, her cultivation progress absurdly fast—he had even suspected she, like himself, harbored some secret. Now the Demonic Path commander's words explained many doubts."

"What exactly do you want? Chen Ji's直直 gaze met the other's eyes, his voice cold. The Demonic Path and the Three Great Sects have confronted each other for tens of thousands of years, yet now they propose cooperation—if not madness, then the stakes are enormous. I do not believe the former applies to the honored one."

choice.prompt: "The Demonic Path commander revealed a shocking secret about Su Qingyao's origins. Chen Ji must decide his next stance."

choices.text: "Agree to preliminary cooperation, set bottom lines"
choices.description: "Dimensional invaders are the true external threat; if Su Qingyao's origins are true, it concerns the greater scheme. Patience in small matters prevents chaos in big ones—temporarily engage with the Demonic Path tactically, wait until their true intentions are understood before making decisions."
choices.visible_cost: "May bear the stigma of colluding with the Demonic Path"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain intelligence support from the Demonic Path and opportunity to protect Su Qingyao"
choices.risk_hint: "The Demonic Path commander may use this as leverage for coercion"

text.content: "Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his expression as calm as if discussing the weather. I am willing to listen to the terms of cooperation, but three things must be made clear—first, Su Qingyao must not be harmed; second, Ye Qing must not be used again; third, the Demonic Path's blade must not be pointed at innocent mortals."

dialogue.content: "(轻笑) Chen Daoist Friend is indeed protective. Rest easy, Ye Qing is no longer a member of the Holy Sect. As for Su Qingyao—we desire her awakening more than anyone."

choices.text: "Demand the other party prove their sincerity first"
choices.description: "Empty words come easy to anyone. If you want me to believe the Demonic Path's goodwill, show me something real. The source of the turtle shell artifact's same-source aura, how you can interfere with fate trajectories—these must be explained clearly."
choices.visible_reward: "Force the other party to reveal more cards and weaknesses"
choices.risk_hint: "The other party is extremely scheming and may reverse-engineer information from us"

text.content: "A mocking弧度 curved at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. Cooperation? The honored one won't even say who you are, yet you want me to expose my back to the Demonic Path? Absurd. He lightly brushed his sleeve cuff, as if dusting off some dirt. If the senior truly has sincerity, perhaps first tell me—what is your relationship with this turtle shell artifact?"

dialogue.content: "(沉默片刻) …I am the remnant soul vessel of the First Generation Fate Scribe. This body is merely borrowed temporarily."

text.content: "As the words fell, the demonic energy around the Demonic Path commander suddenly收敛殆尽. He slowly removed his battle helmet, revealing a face aged and weary—between those brows and eyes, there was a faint resemblance to Mo Xiansheng. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply; a terrible suspicion arose in his heart."

dialogue.content: "No need for surprise. Your Mo Xiansheng was a contingency I personally set in place—using a remnant soul to guard the Tianji Record, awaiting the true inheritor's appearance. I simply never expected the one who would arrive to be a little fox who hides his strength…"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not respond. He was rapidly消化ing this information—if Mo Xiansheng was the Demonic Path commander's contingency, does that mean obtaining the Tianji Record from the very beginning was part of a design? This thought made his back slightly chill, yet his expression remained unmoved. Filed away; I will settle accounts with Mo Xiansheng when I return."

"Regardless of the past, there truly is a common enemy at present. Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice socalm that no emotion could be discerned. I may temporarily cooperate with the Demonic Path, but there is one condition—everything about the dimensional invaders must be shared without reservation, including what exactly happened to the first Fate Scribe whose name was erased."

dialogue.content: "(凝视Chen Ji片刻) Very well. The dimensional invaders will break through the seal on a massive scale in three months.届时… your benefactor should also make their appearance."

text.content: "Before the words even finished, the Demonic Path commander's form flickered, transforming into a black glow that shot skyward, vanishing into the clouds in an instant. The crowd in the plaza这才如梦初醒, clamor arising on all sides. Chen Ji still stood where he was, looking down at the faintly hot turtle shell fragment in his hand, deep in thought. Behind him, Chen Nian怯生生地 tugged at his robe."

dialogue.content: "Ge… that person, so terrifying… there's such浓的 death aura on him…"

text.content: "Chen Ji turned around, for the first time truly looking at this long-lost sister. She was terribly thin, yet her eyes were unexpectedly clear—that kind of clarity that sees through essence,隐隐呼应 with the Tianji Record's perceptual ability. His heart stirred; he suddenly recalled the blurred vision from earlier. Heavenly Fate Key, perhaps is not just a title."

dialogue.content: "(轻叹) Xiao Nian, all these years… you've had it hard. Come, first find a quiet place, and slowly tell Ge what you've been through these eight years."
